notes.title: "Help" Screen Update - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi All,

Please see below the notes for the newest update to EcoGenesis:
[olist]
[*] Added a "Help" screen - this goes into extra detail on a lot of aspects in EcoGenesis. Open it up by pressing the '?' button next to the 'Resources' banner.
[*] Adjusted tutorial text to make it more readable.
[*] Fixed a couple of visual bugs.
[*] Fixed a bug related to the ability "Thermo-Regulating Sails" ability (Spinosaurus)
[*] Fixed some typos.
[/olist]

We're excited to continue to take community feedback into consideration and hear about your experiences with the game.

Thanks for playing!
